# Setup
```{r}
library(Seurat)

root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/")
processed.data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/")
results.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/")
```



# Create Seurat object
```{r}
counts <- ReadMtx(mtx = paste0(data.dir, "Macnair_2024_MS/", "8338963/", "ms_lesions_snRNAseq_cleaned_counts_matrix_2023-09-12.mtx.gz"),
                cells = paste0(data.dir, "Macnair_2024_MS/", "8338963/", "ms_lesions_snRNAseq_col_data_2023-09-12.txt"),
                features = paste0(data.dir, "Macnair_2024_MS/", "8338963/", "ms_lesions_snRNAseq_row_data_2023-09-12.txt"),
                cell.column = 3,
                cell.sep = ",",
                skip.cell = 1,
                feature.column = 3,
                feature.sep = ",",
                skip.feature = 1)

seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts)

metadata.df <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, "Macnair_2024_MS/", "8338963/", "ms_lesions_snRNAseq_col_data_2023-09-12.txt"))
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, metadata.df)
saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(processed.data.dir, "Macnair_2024_MS/", "Mcnair_2024_MS.RDS"))
```
